Account Administration

Manage website accounts, search and sort the user directory, review sign-in activity, disable spam accounts, and revoke sessions.

Review website accounts, find people, and manage access. This directory is available only to the site administrators.

Last sign-in comes from the account's sign-in history. Recorded sign-ins count sessions observed since tracking was enabled, with repeated page visits deduplicated. Earlier totals are unavailable. Disabling preserves the account and its data so it can be enabled again.

Sign in to an administrator account to open this panel.

Administrator accounts are protected. Disabling blocks new sign-ins and private website access. Revoking ends the current sessions; an enabled account can sign in again. Existing services that validate old tokens independently can take up to one hour to recognize revocation. Public tools remain public.
